verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automation logic is a fair question for an auth service, since auth platforms can ship versioned hook or action workflows, so the axis applies. Supabase Auth documents customization via Postgres auth hooks, but the pack has no evidence of versioning, review, or rollback for them. Hooks are an adjacent feature, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
